sections.heading: In-Game Description
sections.text:
Compendium on the Combat Art,"Floating Passage". Skill unlocked upon acquiring this item.
"Unleash attacks in a flowing, dancelike form, overwhelming enemies in a furor of graceful aggression. This technique belongs to the Ashina sword school, though it has been deemed heretical due to its foreign origin."

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Unlocks the Floating Passage Combat Art and makes the Spiral Cloud Passage available for acquisition among the Mushin Esoteric Text Skill Tree.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- Once the Truly Precious Bait of a Pot Noble is given to the Great Carp, the other Noble will disappear from the game for the rest of the playthrough and the remaining one will inherit everything left in the other's stock prior to his disappearance.
- Purchasing this Combat Art is a necessary step to unlock the "Height of Technique" trophy.
- Carries over New Game Plus.
